name: adaptive_max_pool1d
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::adaptive_max_pool1d(Tensor self, int[1] output_size) -> (Tensor, Tensor). Returns pooled values and exact int64 source indices for one-dimensional adaptive max pooling. Coverage spans several batch/channel/length shapes, scalar and one-element-list output sizes, multiple reduction ratios and global pooling. The operation does not mutate self and neither output aliases it. The current FlagGems implementation explicitly does not support autograd.
